goal: Verify that a user can successfully create a new account as the Site Host and then navigate the calendar view forward to the next month and backward to the previous month.
instructions: On the 'Create your account' page, enter 'alice' into the 'Username' field and 'SecureP@ss123!' into the 'Password' field, then click the 'Sign up' button.
Once logged in and viewing the calendar (initially showing June 2026), click the 'Next month' button (right arrow) located next to the month title.
After the calendar updates to show July 2026, click the 'Previous month' button (left arrow) to return to the prior month.
success_criteria: The user is successfully redirected from the sign-up page to the main dashboard view after clicking 'Sign up'.
The calendar header updates to display 'July 2026' after clicking the 'Next month' button.
The calendar header updates back to display 'June 2026' after clicking the 'Previous month' button.
The main content area displays the list of memos or reminders corresponding to the currently selected month.
